12.t: Working with data: fruit battery voltages
q: Which pair gave the highest voltage?
Explain why zinc and zinc gave no voltage.
The two metals must be different.
Describe the pattern with the reactivity series.
The further apart the metals are in the series, the bigger the voltage.
Predict the voltage for magnesium and zinc and explain.
About 0.7 V: Mg-Cu (1.6) minus Zn-Cu (0.9), because zinc lies between magnesium and copper.
